capabilities: Render tikz code blocks as SVG diagrams in notes
Compile TeX offline with a bundled WebAssembly engine
Cache diagrams and resume from saved preambles for faster compiles
Copy, save, or finalize diagrams as SVG attachments
Report TeX errors with line numbers and show engine diagnostics
disambiguation: Not a general LaTeX renderer; diagrams must go in tikz code fences because TikZ in $$ math blocks is handled by MathJax and does not work.
extras: The ~12 MB main.js exceeds Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB file cap, so synced devices need manual reinstallation. Extensive FAQ, troubleshooting (including iOS Lockdown Mode), and roadmap live in the README and wiki.
intentEvidence: It is a fork of artisticat1/obsidian-tikzjax, which had not been updated since 2022.
motivation: The author forked artisticat1/obsidian-tikzjax, unmaintained since 2022, to own the whole rendering pipeline, modernize the toolchain, and make TeX compilation faster.
problem: Obsidian cannot render TikZ or LaTeX diagrams on its own, and the original TikZJax plugin was unmaintained, slow, and gave poor error reporting.

relations.evidence: It is a fork of artisticat1/obsidian-tikzjax, which had not been updated since 2022.
Jim Fowler wrote TikZJax and web2js, which is the hard part and the reason any of this is possible.

summary: Fork of TikZJax that renders TikZ and LaTeX code blocks as SVG diagrams using a bundled offline WebAssembly TeX engine, with caching and faster compiles.
